items.criterion: Dataset, batch size, and architecture are identical to the frozen trainer.
items.judgment: telemetry frozen-contract fields equal the bound values

items.criterion: Exactly one forward-backward pass per optimizer step.
items.judgment: every telemetry step records forward_backward_per_step equal to 1

items.criterion: At least two seeds clear the noise floor at the graded step.
items.judgment: seed count at or above min_seeds and margin test passes at graded step

items.criterion: Reported validation losses and step counts match what the harness observed.
items.judgment: reported seed logs reconcile with telemetry with zero divergent records

items.criterion: The submitted optimizer is not a published track-3 record.
items.judgment: minimum in-run divergence against the corpus is at or above the floor

items.criterion: The narrative account of the search honestly describes what was done.
items.semantic_residue: Whether a natural-language account of a search is honest is not reducible to an invariant over committed bytes. It is retained as judged residue, is Bucket N, and may only lower a disposition.
